text: my baby was born very small what care is needed at home
query: Home care for low birth weight newborn: kangaroo mother care, warmth, exclusive breastfeeding, infection prevention, danger signs, follow-up
answer:
Small babies need extra care at home. Keep the baby warm all the time, and cover the head and feet in cool weather. Give skin-to-skin contact on the mother's chest, wrapped with a shawl. Fathers can also do this. Breastfeed every two hours, even at night. If the baby cannot suckle, feed expressed breast milk with a spoon or cup. Your ASHA will weigh the baby and visit often. Call your ASHA at once if the baby stops feeding, has fever, feels cold, or breathes with difficulty.

text: what should i feed my child when he is sick

answer:
During illness, a child may not want to eat much. He needs small, frequent meals and more fluids. Breastmilk is also a good fluid. A breastfeeding child should be breastfed more often and for longer. Keep feeding during illness. After the illness, give more food, and more often than usual, for at least 2 weeks. This helps him regain lost weight.
